description: Source code for a RouterBOOT configuration utility, including functions for reading, modifying, and writing configuration data stored in MTD devices, with command-line interface for managing configuration options.

methods.name: usage
methods.description: Displays usage information and available commands.

methods.name: cpuinfo_find_soc
methods.description: Detects the system-on-chip type by parsing /proc/cpuinfo.

methods.name: fixup_rbcfg_envs
methods.description: Adjusts configuration environment options based on detected SoC.

methods.name: rbcfg_find_tag
methods.description: Finds a specific tag in the configuration buffer.

methods.name: rbcfg_get_u32
methods.description: Retrieves a 32-bit value from the configuration buffer by tag ID.

methods.name: rbcfg_set_u32
methods.description: Sets a 32-bit value in the configuration buffer by tag ID.

methods.name: rbcfg_find_mtd
methods.description: Finds the MTD device corresponding to a given name.

methods.name: rbcfg_check_tmp
methods.description: Checks if temporary configuration file is valid.

methods.name: rbcfg_load
methods.description: Loads configuration data from the device or temporary file.

methods.name: rbcfg_open
methods.description: Initializes context and loads configuration.

methods.name: rbcfg_update
methods.description: Writes configuration data back to device or temporary file.

methods.name: rbcfg_close
methods.description: Frees context resources.

methods.name: rbcfg_env_find
methods.description: Finds a value in environment options by name.

methods.name: rbcfg_env_find_u32
methods.description: Finds a value in environment options by numeric value.

methods.name: rbcfg_env_get_u32
methods.description: Gets the current value of an environment option as a string.

methods.name: rbcfg_env_set_u32
methods.description: Sets the value of an environment option from a string.

methods.name: rbcfg_env_get
methods.description: Retrieves the current value of an environment option.

methods.name: rbcfg_env_set
methods.description: Sets the value of an environment option.

methods.name: rbcfg_cmd_apply
methods.description: Command to apply configuration changes.

methods.name: rbcfg_cmd_help
methods.description: Command to display help information.

methods.name: rbcfg_cmd_get
methods.description: Command to get the value of a configuration option.

methods.name: rbcfg_cmd_set
methods.description: Command to set the value of a configuration option.

methods.name: rbcfg_cmd_show
methods.description: Command to show all configuration options.
